steps.action: Isolate compromised host from internal network
steps.command: iptables -A FORWARD -s {src_ip} -j DROP && iptables -A FORWARD -d {src_ip} -j DROP
steps.description: Stop the compromised host from pivoting further through the network.

steps.action: Block scan traffic to sensitive ports
steps.command: iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 445 -j DROP && iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 3389 -j DROP
steps.description: Block SMB and RDP access to prevent further compromise attempts.

steps.action: Identify compromised account on source host
steps.description: Identify which user account is being used for lateral movement.

steps.action: Review process execution on source host
steps.description: Review auditd records for discovery commands (whoami, net, ipconfig).

steps.action: Check for scheduled tasks or persistence mechanisms
steps.description: Look for persistence mechanisms installed by the attacker.

steps.action: Enumerate network connections from compromised host
steps.description: Map all active connections to understand lateral movement scope.

steps.action: Kill suspicious processes on compromised host
steps.description: Terminate any malicious processes identified during investigation.

steps.action: Remove any dropped payloads or scripts
steps.description: Locate and remove any attacker-dropped tools or scripts.

steps.action: Document incident with MITRE T1021.002 + T1046 mapping
steps.description: File incident report including full network scan scope and pivot path.
